01 / CONTEXT

The project

A proposed parental monitoring platform extending the wider parental-control idea into a service-oriented product. Its feature list describes an intended scope.

02 / PRODUCT SCOPE

What it covers

  • Website filtering, app blocking, and screen-time limits.
  • Activity reports and location monitoring.
  • AI-assisted safety insights.

This describes the intended or related scope. It is not a claim that every feature is complete.

03 / CONTRIBUTION

My involvement

Product concept exploration. The proposed capabilities are not presented as implemented or released.

04 / DEVELOPMENT DETAILS

Work in focus

  • Explored a broader parental-monitoring service concept.
  • Privacy, consent, permissions, and implementation would require further design.
  • No operational monitoring service is claimed.

Project status

Proposed concept related to GuardianX. The mobile prototype and the SaaS proposal are different stages of related work.
